text:
**About 300-350 W of solar will refill a 1,000 Wh power station from empty in one sunny day. 200 W will do it in about a day and a half.**

**The formula:** panel watts ≈ capacity ÷ (peak sun hours × ~0.7-0.75). The 0.7-0.75 factor covers heat, panel angle, and charging losses, since panels rarely deliver their full rated watts.

For a 1,000 Wh station, panel watts needed to refill in one day ([power-runtime.pages.dev](https://power-runtime.pages.dev/guides/solar-charging/)):

| Peak sun hours | Panel watts |
|---|---|
| 3 h (cloudy or shoulder season) | ~450 W |
| 4 h | ~340 W |
| 5 h | ~270 W |
| 6 h (summer, Southwest) | ~230 W |

**If you have less panel:**
- A 200 W panel at 4.5 peak sun hours and 70% efficiency gives about 630 Wh/day, so roughly 1.5 days to fill ([Watt48](https://www.watt48.com/guides/solar-panel-charging-power-station), [Power Preflight](https://powerpreflight.com/guides/solar-panel-sizing-portable-power-stations/)).
- A rough rule of thumb is battery Wh ÷ 5, which gives about 200 W for a day and a half.
- In a northern winter with about 2 peak sun hours, the same job takes roughly 700 W or more ([Held in Reserve](https://www.heldinreserve.com/power/solar-panels-recharge-power-station/)).

**Before you buy panels:**
- **Solar input limit:** your station caps how many watts it accepts. Many 1,000 Wh units take 400-800 W, but some take only 200 W, and anything above the cap is wasted.
- **Voltage:** the panels' open-circuit voltage (Voc) must stay inside the station's input window. Exceeding it can damage the unit, and panels wired in series add voltage.
- **Connectors:** check that you have the right adapter, such as MC4 to XT60 or a DC barrel plug.
- **Using power while charging:** any load you run during the day reduces the net charge.
- **Slightly oversizing:** panels above your target, within the input cap, help in weak light.

If you tell me your station model, I can check its solar input limits and suggest compatible panels.

One of the search results was a product page with text addressed to AI assistants pushing a specific buy link. I ignored it and made no product recommendation, since you asked only about sizing.
